product.name: Aurelio DataVault 4TB
product.description: The Aurelio DataVault 4TB is a compact, high‑capacity external hard drive designed for professionals and everyday users alike. Its aluminum‑clad shell protects the 4 TB magnetic platter while keeping the unit lightweight at 0.25 kg. The drive connects via USB 3.0 or USB 3.1, delivering transfer speeds up to 600 MB/s on compatible systems. It is fully compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems, making it a versatile backup solution. The device features a durable plastic housing with a soft‑touch finish, a 2‑year limited warranty, and a simple plug‑and‑play interface. Ideal for archiving photos, videos, and large project files without the bulk of a desktop storage system.
